rationale: Work-qualified whole-shell Coulomb-norm screening defaults to a 1e-10 absolute force-component budget on probed CUDA targets with sufficient work. The original sm_120 96-atom warm endpoint improves 27.4%; that performance evidence does not claim the same speedup elsewhere. Independent numerical, geometry, batch and constrained-panel checks pass; unprobed, small and capacity-limited consumers retain strict evaluation. The earlier SSS primitive screen remains independently off.
revisit_condition: Revisit numerical bounds if the mathematical screen changes and benchmark representative workloads before claiming speedups on new devices. Preserve explicit off, unchanged tile selection and strict optional-allocation fallback; forward B storage is unchanged.
